description: This file implements Bluetooth Audio Capability Management functions for Zephyr OS, including discovery, connection handling, and processing of Bluetooth Audio Streaming (BAP) and CSIP (Coordinated Set Identification Profile) features.

methods.name: bt_cap_common_get_active_proc
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the current active Bluetooth capability process.

methods.name: bt_cap_common_clear_active_proc
methods.description: Clears the active process data.

methods.name: bt_cap_common_start_proc
methods.description: Starts a new capability process with specified type and count.

methods.name: bt_cap_common_set_subproc
methods.description: Sets the sub-process type for the active process.

methods.name: bt_cap_common_subproc_is_type
methods.description: Checks if the active sub-process matches the given type.

methods.name: bt_cap_common_get_member_conn
methods.description: Retrieves the connection associated with a member based on set type.

methods.name: bt_cap_common_proc_is_active
methods.description: Checks if a process is currently active.

methods.name: bt_cap_common_proc_is_aborted
methods.description: Checks if the current process has been aborted.

methods.name: bt_cap_common_proc_all_handled
methods.description: Checks if all initiated process steps are handled.

methods.name: bt_cap_common_proc_is_done
methods.description: Checks if the process is completed.

methods.name: bt_cap_common_abort_proc
methods.description: Aborts the current process with an error and connection info.

methods.name: bt_cap_common_conn_in_active_proc
methods.description: Checks if a connection is part of the active process.

methods.name: bt_cap_common_stream_in_active_proc
methods.description: Checks if a stream is part of the active process.

methods.name: bt_cap_common_disconnected
methods.description: Handles disconnection event, cleans up client and aborts process if needed.

methods.name: bt_cap_common_get_client_by_acl
methods.description: Retrieves client info by ACL connection.

methods.name: bt_cap_common_get_client_by_csis
methods.description: Retrieves client info by CSIS instance.

methods.name: bt_cap_common_get_client
methods.description: Retrieves client info based on set type and member.

methods.name: cap_common_discover_complete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon discovery completion.

methods.name: csis_client_discover_cb
methods.description: Callback for CSIS client discovery process.

methods.name: bt_cap_common_discover
methods.description: Initiates GATT discovery for Bluetooth Audio Capability Service.
